bullets.title: On Needing to Find Something to Worry About.
bullets.note: I expected a fluff piece based on the headline. Instead, I got an incredible (and incredibly short) essay that I saved to [Evernote](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/qdurox544u7h0we79/xvfph6hk92q52/aHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVybm90ZS5jb20v) and now read several times per month. It won’t apply to everyone, but for some of you, like me, it will have a pronounced “Oh…. fuck” realization that could change things. Once you read it, I bet you’ll be able to guess which specific line carried the most weight for me.

bullets.title: Peak Design Everyday Backpack 20L
bullets.note: This was given to me as a gift, and, truth be told, I let it sit for months. This is because I stupidly tossed the literature aside and tried to use it like a normal backpack, which it isn’t. One day, when I sat down and actually read the instructions (yes, read them), I was blown away and embarrassed that I’d waited so long. Most of the features are non-obvious and incredibly helpful. Note: I load everything from the sides and only use the top latch (as cool as it may be) for stuffing in a sweatshirt or workout clothing. This was the key decision after reading everything.

bullets.title: Putumayo presents
bullets.note: **_[Brasileiro](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/qdurox544u7h0we79/q9s8h7heowk95/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj1Wd1lNOGRadWFLdw==)._** This is the album I listened to every morning while working on [_Tools of Titans_](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/qdurox544u7h0we79/3raphkhx4mpee/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9Ub29scy1UaXRhbnMtQmlsbGlvbmFpcmVzLVdvcmxkLUNsYXNzLVBlcmZvcm1lcnMvZHAvMTMyODY4Mzc4OA==) and [_Tribe of Mentors_](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/qdurox544u7h0we79/40bvhehw6lx4x/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9UcmliZS1NZW50b3JzLVNob3J0LUFkdmljZS1Xb3JsZC9kcC8xMzI4OTk0OTYx). It was my wake-up-and-have-yerba-mate soundtrack, to which I would sip tea, scribble down “[morning pages](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/qdurox544u7h0we79/rzh8hohkwd6go/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE1LzAxLzE1L21vcm5pbmctcGFnZXMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTViZg==),” and then get to work editing the draft chapters from the night before. bullets.title: "Hope is not a strategy. Luck is not a factor. Fear is not an option.” — James Cameron

“Do not spoil what you have by desiring what you have not; remember that what you now have was once among the things you only hoped for.” ― Epicurus For my friends spread across the U.S., I wish you and yours a most joyous Thanksgiving holiday! And to all of my friends out there, spread across the globe, please accept my sincerest gratitude. If it weren’t for y’all, I wouldn’t be here, have this weird “career,” or be nearly as excited for 2019 as I am. There is much adventure coming! With heartfelt thanks, I am sending much love to you and yours… 🙏
